header.name: Machine Learning
header.description: Machine Learning has become a core discipline underpinning modern artificial intelligence and data-driven decision making across diverse application domains. This course provides a rigorous treatment of the theoretical foundations and practical methodologies of ML techniques. Through analytical assignments, programming exercises, and a comprehensive course project, students will develop end-to-end machine learning solutions involving data preprocessing, feature engineering, model development, hyperparameter optimization, validation, and performance analysis on real-world datasets. The course emphasizes both methodological understanding and the ability to critically evaluate and design machine learning systems for complex research and industrial applications.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to explain different types of learning problems along with some techniques to solve them

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to model real-world problems, apply different learning techniques and quantitatively evaluate the performance

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to Identify and use advanced techniques through existing machine learning tools and libraries

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to analyze performance of ML techniques and comment on their limitations
